## Purpose

Describe the task and link the relevant PA requirement or project document.

## Ownership and Dates

- Assignee: assign exactly one member using the issue's Assignees control
- Reviewer: pending (a different member; required from PA2)
- Created: actual issue creation timestamp
- Assigned: record the actual date/time
- Due: pending
- Completed: fill in only when the work is finished
- External board link: if the team uses another board

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Describe the observable result
- [ ] Record the relevant verification or evidence

## Result and Review

Fill in after the work and review actually happen. Link the changed documents, commits, or PR. Do not create retrospective task history or claim checks that were not run.
